title: Harness Policy Distillation: Aligning Agent Policies with Runtime Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2610.20261v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying a general-purpose model as an agent means running it inside a product-specific runtime harness that decides which actions are executable, how state advances, and when the loop may terminate. Ordinary trajectory supervision shows which action was taken but leaves the runtime semantics behind that action implicit. We introduce Harness Policy Distillation (HPD), which makes these runtime control semantics an explicit training target alongside actions to align the harness policy. HPD replays reference trajectories through the harness to recover the runtime semantics that are implicit in ordinary trajectory data, and represents them as control documents at each model-call boundary. These documents provide privileged information for a teacher to generate actions, while harness verification ensures that the resulting targets are executable under the runtime contract. translated_title: 框架策略蒸馏：使智能体策略与运行时语义对齐
translated_abstract: 将通用模型部署为智能体，意味着要在特定产品的运行时框架中运行它，该框架决定哪些动作是可执行的、状态如何推进、以及循环何时可以终止。普通的轨迹监督只显示采取了哪个动作，却将该动作背后的运行时语义保持在隐式状态。我们提出框架策略蒸馏，它将这些运行时控制语义与动作一起作为显式的训练目标，以对齐框架策略。HPD 通过框架重放参考轨迹，以恢复普通轨迹数据中隐含的运行时语义，并将其表示为每个模型调用边界处的控制文档。这些文档为教师模型生成动作提供了特权信息，同时框架验证确保由此产生的目标在运行时契约下是可执行的。我们在恢复的运行时语义上联合训练共享模型……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出框架策略蒸馏（HPD）：通过在运行时框架中重放参考轨迹，将普通轨迹数据中隐含的运行时控制语义恢复为模型调用边界处的控制文档并作为显式训练目标，再借助框架验证保证目标可执行，从而实现智能体策略与运行时语义的对齐。
en_tdlr: Harness Policy Distillation (HPD) makes implicit runtime control semantics an explicit training target by replaying reference trajectories through the harness, representing them as control documents at model-call boundaries, and using harness verification to ensure executable targets, thereby aligning agent policies with runtime semantics.
